      "section": "mod-tome/data/zones/ruins-kor-pul/npcs.lua",
      "source": "The Shade's colossal will keeps it anchored to this world, now as a vengeful, insane spirit.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "暗影骷髅强大的意志使它滞留于这个世界，如今它化作了一个充满复仇欲的疯狂灵魂。"
    },
    {

      "section": "mod-tome/data/zones/sandworm-lair/objects.lua",
      "source": "#00FF00#You gain an affinity for nature. You can now learn new Harmony talents (press p).",
      "source_tag": "logPlayer",
      "special": null,
      "target": "#00FF00#你获得了与自然的紧密联系，现在你可以学习新的自然协调系技能（按 P 键）。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",

      "notes": "Lite review batch 0153 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/zones/sandworm-lair/objects.lua",
      "source": "One of the ruby eyes of the legendary giant golem Atamathon.\nIt is said it was made by the halflings during the Age of Pyre as a weapon against the orcs. Even though it was destroyed it managed to deal a crippling blow by killing their leader, Garkul the Devourer.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "传奇巨型傀儡阿塔玛森的红宝石眼睛之一。\n据说阿塔玛森是半身人在烈火纪为了对抗兽人所造的武器。这具傀儡虽然最终被毁，但还是成功杀死了兽人首领吞噬者加库尔，给兽人以重创。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "fbdc06a5328011850156053c460df7b2ad7c6c395438b58dbdae461b5d4f2aed",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0153 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/zones/sandworm-lair/npcs.lua",
      "source": "Did you hear? Something seems to have devoured all the last sandworms!",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "你听说了吗？似乎有什么东西把剩下的沙虫全都吞噬了！"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "d2f525287442b0fe0f3af13c872380d35d9740d4458b067da952666c97b438aa",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0153 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/zones/sandworm-lair/objects.lua",
      "source": "The heart of the Sandworm Queen, ripped from her dead body.\nYou could ... consume it, should you feel mad enough or you could try to corrupt it somewhere.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "从沙虫女皇尸体上割下的心脏。\n如果你足够疯狂，可以……吃下它；或者，你也可以试着找个地方腐化它。"
    }
